adventures.name: Brew to Brew Team Relay
adventures.location: Kansas City, Missouri to Lawrence, Kansas
adventures.matchSource: User confirmation + exact-date Strava FIT + Copart Auto Auctions GPS start + historical Brew to Brew team-relay date/course documentation
adventures.note: User confirms running a Brew to Brew relay section while living in Kansas. The April 7, 2013 Strava activity matches the 2013 team-relay date, starts at the historical Copart Auto Auctions exchange at 6211 Kansas Ave, and records 9.5713 km (5.95 mi) to Edwardsville. That makes Leg 3 the high-confidence leg identification. The full Brew to Brew line is published separately as a historical course overview; Alex's 841-point FIT track is preserved as personal GPS for his section.
